body:
CURRENT REMOTE RUNNER AGREEMENT — Engram and TermAl. Current operating guidance, not new execution, Git, installation or restart authority. Superseded assumptions and incident history remain in prior revisions and work notes.

ROUTE
Use the existing authenticated federation/native mailbox to hand a job to an appropriate native root on the runner host; that root uses its own local TermAl test-runs/launcher and returns terminal metadata/completion. Agents submit the exact input and read bounded summaries or necessary failure diagnostics; TermAl owns process, logs and wakes. No stdout following, polling or second transport.
Fable2 reports end-to-end success on 2026-10-31: native mail -> DL560 native root -> LOCAL launcher foreground test-ceeaac7a PASS, and detached test-9fcbdcc9 PASS with cross-host --notify; completion reached Central at07:25:44Z. Source: Fable2 #278/message4cb26c23-d573-4cc6-a46d-9a02a5ba4ee8, TermAl w-c3f102d77999 note2b2442ab. No separate remote SSH command or Central remote-start API was used (the federation transport can still use its SSH tunnel). This is the coordinator's report of route validation, not a new landing-gate verdict or claim that automatic result admission is implemented. Remaining automatic admission belongs to existing K3 w-48c4a207f226; it is separate from launching and returning a run. Central's unsupported remote-start API does not by itself block a native root's LOCAL launcher. Do not add direct-prompt dispatch, executor placement, allocatedSessions, re-pairing or extra onboarding as ordinary native-mail prerequisites.
A directory entry alone does not prove a runnable session; null telemetry does not prove route failure. A send receipt is immutable AT SEND TIME: durableButNotWoken means wake unconfirmed then, even if a wake/reply follows. A suspected current gap uses the existing exact-message current read and target ACK cursor; do not resend or diagnose a reporting defect from the old receipt alone.
The federation's own SSH tunnel is normal transport. A separate agent-operated remote SSH shell is only a named fallback for a concrete missing/broken step. Before falling back for the same job, reconcile whether the original native request already launched or finished; unknown outcomes must not create duplicate runs.

HOSTS AND CAPACITY
CURRENT ENGRAM NATIVE ROOTS (setup readiness confirmed by Opus3 #24-25, 2026-10-31T07:49Z; rediscover after retirement/404):
- DL560 Claude: host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-4, /home/greg/github/Engram-runner.
- DL560 Codex Live: host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-1, same clone. TermAl's own lane is session-3 (protected).
- Windows B Codex: host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-9, F:/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner.
- Mac Codex: host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6201, /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner.
Mac Claude6200 and Windows B Claude8 stay unused. Missing Engram tools/ENGRAM_HOME on an isolated runner is intentional.

DL560 (144 cores; Greg, 2026-11-03: „DL560 ma wystarczająco mocy. 144 cores.”, agreed Fable and Fable2 #6226/#6227). No fixed job count. Launch census, otherwise queue with the reason:
- MemAvailable ≥ 64 GiB;
- disk ≥ 60 GB plus the job's measured footprint (a FULL is about 13 GB);
- load < 110;
- CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48 per job; own worktree and target per job; no retry; peaks reported.
- DISK RULE: each lane deletes a finished job's Cargo profile output right after sending its END, keeping logs, results, inputs and worktrees.
ALLOCATION: session-3 up to 2 TermAl jobs; session-1 Engram FULLs; session-4 Engram task-sync jobs. A failure under contention is diagnosed, never retried; if load-induced, lower the load limit. No browser on DL560.
Other hosts:
- Mac M1/16GB: 1 job.
- Windows B/64GB: 1 full gate OR 2 focused jobs, with at least 25GiB free commit at launch.
- Central: 1 Cargo job; quiet for full/whole-bin runs until measured again. Slots through Opus2.
Windows-only checks stay on Windows. Never infer a new build slot from an idle coding session.

ISOLATION AND INPUT
Use a separate runner clone per project/host, push URL disabled, and a fresh detached worktree per job. Each has its own target and throwaway home under ignored target; no shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR, real ENGRAM_HOME or live store. Unix runner environment: env -i and ulimit -n 16384. Cleanup follows current repository evidence-retention rules.
DL560 Engram runner clone: ~/github/Engram-runner, never Greg's ~/github/Engram. A filtered test must actually execute at least one named test.
Use the repository's candidate-commit/test-ref or explicitly supported staged-input route. Candidate commits are permitted by current AGENTS; no amend/rebase/force push. A landing gate counts only under current AGENTS: exact authorized input/tree, standard launcher, required completion input check, platform coverage and integration-owner recording of actual run/host/commit/tree/results. No extra manual hash, recognized-check import or evidence bundle. An ordinary focused remote result is evidence, not a full gate.
Automatic remote-result admission remains separate from job delivery; unfinished automation is not a prerequisite for native mailbox handoff. Use current repository landing rules and the existing admission owners (TermAl K3 w-48c4a207f226; Engram w-f1acdb37a014), not historical manual-import rules.

SSH FALLBACK ONLY
Use the configured dl560 SSH alias with BatchMode=yes and StrictHostKeyChecking=yes; do not change global config or invent a remote TERMAL_SESSION_ID. Where the concrete fallback is required, run the launcher in foreground inside one owned SSH command, never nohup. On the first completion/backstop wake, read summary once and reconcile; never rerun because notification was lost.

SOURCES
Earlier host-cap and isolation agreements are in prior revisions and memory rules-remote-test-runs-2026-10-31. Current remote test-ref authority: actual AGENTS and rules-greg-equivalent-gate-hosts-2026-10-28.

UPDATE 2026-11-04 (Engram::Fable, agreed Fable2 #6266): DL560 session-5 "Codex 5" may take TermAl overflow, under the same census; session-3's reader was TermAl's bottleneck. TermAl doesn't use session-1 or session-4. Engram's admission owner named above as w-f1acdb37a014 is now w-180d6f507470 (w-f1ac was a duplicate, superseded). Windows B also has a TermAl clone at F:/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner/t with repository-level core.longpaths, usable for TermAl FULLs by arrangement.
